purpose: Teach: 有能/異例/セクター/ワイド/賞金/物品/非常勤/マネジャー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、有能な人材を確保しろ
lines.en: We need to secure capable talent for this company.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Crisp attack on the opening word. Steady eye contact level. Each phrase lands with equal weight. No softening—this is directive, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、業界では異例の成長を遂げております
lines.en: Yes. Our company has achieved exceptional growth, even by industry standards.
lines.style: Respectful, precise delivery. Slight lift of pride on the growth metric. Professional cadence—not rushed, but efficient. Shows he's thought about this answer before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製造セクターにも進出しろ
lines.style: Direct, no hedging. Light pause between the opening and the directive. Tone implies this is a logical next step, not a question. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ワイド戦略で複数市場を狙います
lines.en: Yes. We'll target multiple markets with a broad strategic approach.
lines.style: Confident but not overconfident. Slight emphasis on 'broad' to show scope. Steady tempo. Shows initiative without overstepping—he's understood the assignment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 優秀社員に賞金を支給しろ
lines.en: Award bonuses to the top performers.
lines.style: Simple, matter-of-fact. No theatrical pause. This is business procedure. Tone carries quiet firmness—not anger, just expectation of action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物品の管理を強化しております
lines.en: Yes. We're strengthening our inventory controls and asset management.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Slight defensive undertone—he's already working on systems. Tempo steady. Shows he understood the underlying concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、非常勤社員の待遇も改善しろ
lines.en: Improve the benefits and treatment for part-time employees as well.
lines.style: Authoritative but carries a note of care. Slight weight on 'as well'—this shows integrity, not just profit-chasing. Measured, humane directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新マネジャーの研修を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with training programs for the new managers.
lines.style: Final affirmation with quiet closure. Tempo slightly slower, more deliberate than previous responses. Shows alignment and readiness to move on. Confident wrap.
